content: User requires split-horizon DNS resolution for their DuckDNS subdomain charlie1990.duckdns.org: when accessed from devices on their local network (e.g., their phone), the domain must resolve to the local LAN IP 192.168.123.1 instead of the public WAN IP, to enable low-latency, NAT loopback-free access to the self-hosted service running on port 8648 at that local IP.
